messages.subject: Black Box Displayed
parts:
When my app first loads...I am seeing a black box displayed on the screen where the plot should be.

My app is designed to have a file read in via fileInput() and then display a few graphs. When the app loads for the first time I see a black box (see load image below). I then select a file to load and the box turns light grey (see fileInput image below) before finally displaying the desired charts (see loaded image below).

If the input file has not been provided yet...I am at a loss as to why the chart area is displayed as a black box until I select a file as input. I am running Chrome Version 30.0.1599.69 m. Any help/ideas are appreciated.

ui.R snippet
 sidebarPanel(
            
            fileInput('file1', 'Choose Decode Data File',
                      accept=c('text/csv', 'text/comma-separated-values,text/plain'))
      ),

server.R snippet
 output$graph <- renderPlot({
           
            if (is.null(input$file1))
                  return(NULL)
            
            inFile <- input$file1
            
            data = read.delim(inFile$datapath, header=T)
            print(ggplot(data, aes(x=x,y=y)) + geom_line())

)}

parts:
Hi,

This happens to me when running my app, locally, in a windows environment, where R uses cairo as default graphical output.

When running on a linux server (like spark, or a custom shiny-server setup), this black box won't appears again.

So, you can either disable cairo as your default engine (but then, for sure, the plots aren't smoothed...), run this app on a server, or get used to this black box :)

Hope this helps,

Robin

The plot works correctly outside the reactive context, and the subsetting seems to be working correctly using renderVerbatimText(). 

The applet is at http://vanderplas.dyndns-remote.com/Shiny/SoybeanApp/

I've created a reproducible example here: 

ui.R
library(shiny)

# Define UI for page that allows selection of genetic lines with corresponding facets
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  
  headerPanel("Soybean Copy Number Variants"),
  
  # Sidebar with a slider input for number of observations
  sidebarPanel(
    helpText("Choose the varieties and chromosomes you would like to display CNVs from"),
    uiOutput("VarietyList"), 
    uiOutput("ChromosomeList"),
    submitButton("Update View")
  ),
  
  # Show a plot of the relevant chromosomes and varieties
  mainPanel(
    plotOutput("ChromosomePlot"),
    verbatimTextOutput("DebugText")
  )
))

server.R: 
library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)

# Reproducible example
segranges.df2 <- data.frame(
  seqnames=rep(c("A", "B"), each=10),
  start=rep(c(1:10), times=2), 
  end=rep(c(2:11), times=2),
  Variety="1", 
  count=rnorm(20, 32, 4)
)

res.df <- data.frame(
  seqnames=rep(c("A", "B"), each=2),
  start=c(1, 3, 5, 9),
  end=c(2, 4, 6, 10),
  Variety="1"
)

# Define server logic required to generate and plot a subset of varieties with a subset of chromosomes
shinyServer(function(input, output) {

  output$VarietyList <- renderUI({
    varieties <- sort(unique(res.df$Variety))
    checkboxGroupInput("varieties", "Choose Varieties", varieties)
  })
  
  output$ChromosomeList <- renderUI({
    chrs <- unique(res.df$seqnames)
    checkboxGroupInput("chromosomes", "Choose Chromosomes", chrs)
  })
  
  
  # Expression that generates a plot of the distribution. The expression
  # is wrapped in a call to renderPlot to indicate that:
  #
  #  1) It is "reactive" and therefore should be automatically 
  #     re-executed when inputs change
  #  2) Its output type is a plot 
  #
  output$ChromosomePlot <- renderPlot({
#     ggplot() + 
#       geom_text(data=unique(subset(segranges.df2, 
#                             seqnames%in%input$chromosomes &
#                             Variety%in%input$varieties)[,c(1, 3)]),
#                 aes(x=seqnames, y=Variety, label=Variety))
    ggplot() + 
      geom_rect(data=subset(segranges.df2, 
                            seqnames%in%input$chromosomes &
                            Variety%in%input$varieties), 
                aes(xmin=start, xmax=end, ymin=-.5, ymax=.5,
                    fill=count, colour=count)) + 
      scale_fill_gradient("# Reads", trans="log", 
                          low="#FFFFFF", high="#000000", 
                          breaks=c(1, 20, 400, 8000, 160000), 
                          na.value="#FFFFFF") + 
      scale_colour_gradient("# Reads", trans="log", 
                            low="#FFFFFF", high="#000000",
                            breaks=c(1, 20, 400, 8000, 160000),
                            na.value="#FFFFFF") + 
      geom_rect(data=subset(res.df, 
                            seqnames%in%input$chromosomes & 
                            Variety%in%input$varieties), 
                aes(xmin=start, xmax=end, ymin=-.6, ymax=.6),
                fill="green", colour="green") +  
      facet_grid(Variety~seqnames, scales="free") +  
      theme_bw() + 
      theme(axis.text.y=element_blank(), 
            axis.ticks.y=element_blank(), 
            axis.title.y=element_blank())
    
  })
  
  output$DebugText <- renderPrint({
    print(input$chromosomes)
    print(input$varieties)
    head(subset(res.df, 
                seqnames%in%input$chromosomes & 
                Variety%in%input$varieties))
    head(subset(segranges.df2, 
                seqnames%in%input$chromosomes &
                Variety%in%input$varieties))
  })
})

The plot works correctly outside the reactive context, and the subsetting seems to be working correctly using renderVerbatimText(). 

The applet is at http://vanderplas.dyndns-remote.com/Shiny/SoybeanApp/

I've created a reproducible example here: 

ui.R
library(shiny)

# Define UI for page that allows selection of genetic lines with corresponding facets
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  
  headerPanel("Soybean Copy Number Variants"),
  
  # Sidebar with a slider input for number of observations
  sidebarPanel(
    helpText("Choose the varieties and chromosomes you would like to display CNVs from"),
    uiOutput("VarietyList"), 
    uiOutput("ChromosomeList"),
    submitButton("Update View")
  ),
  
  # Show a plot of the relevant chromosomes and varieties
  mainPanel(
    plotOutput("ChromosomePlot"),
    verbatimTextOutput("DebugText")
  )
))

server.R: 
library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)

# Reproducible example
segranges.df2 <- data.frame(
  seqnames=rep(c("A", "B"), each=10),
  start=rep(c(1:10), times=2), 
  end=rep(c(2:11), times=2),
  Variety="1", 
  count=rnorm(20, 32, 4)
)

res.df <- data.frame(
  seqnames=rep(c("A", "B"), each=2),
  start=c(1, 3, 5, 9),
  end=c(2, 4, 6, 10),
  Variety="1"
)

# Define server logic required to generate and plot a subset of varieties with a subset of chromosomes
shinyServer(function(input, output) {

  output$VarietyList <- renderUI({
    varieties <- sort(unique(res.df$Variety))
    checkboxGroupInput("varieties", "Choose Varieties", varieties)
  })
  
  output$ChromosomeList <- renderUI({
    chrs <- unique(res.df$seqnames)
    checkboxGroupInput("chromosomes", "Choose Chromosomes", chrs)
  })
  
  
  # Expression that generates a plot of the distribution. The expression
  # is wrapped in a call to renderPlot to indicate that:
  #
  #  1) It is "reactive" and therefore should be automatically 
  #     re-executed when inputs change
  #  2) Its output type is a plot 
  #
  output$ChromosomePlot <- renderPlot({
#     ggplot() + 
#       geom_text(data=unique(subset(segranges.df2, 
#                             seqnames%in%input$chromosomes &
#                             Variety%in%input$varieties)[,c(1, 3)]),
#                 aes(x=seqnames, y=Variety, label=Variety))
    ggplot() + 
      geom_rect(data=subset(segranges.df2, 
                            seqnames%in%input$chromosomes &
                            Variety%in%input$varieties), 
                aes(xmin=start, xmax=end, ymin=-.5, ymax=.5,
                    fill=count, colour=count)) + 
      scale_fill_gradient("# Reads", trans="log", 
                          low="#FFFFFF", high="#000000", 
                          breaks=c(1, 20, 400, 8000, 160000), 
                          na.value="#FFFFFF") + 
      scale_colour_gradient("# Reads", trans="log", 
                            low="#FFFFFF", high="#000000",
                            breaks=c(1, 20, 400, 8000, 160000),
                            na.value="#FFFFFF") + 
      geom_rect(data=subset(res.df, 
                            seqnames%in%input$chromosomes & 
                            Variety%in%input$varieties), 
                aes(xmin=start, xmax=end, ymin=-.6, ymax=.6),
                fill="green", colour="green") +  
      facet_grid(Variety~seqnames, scales="free") +  
      theme_bw() + 
      theme(axis.text.y=element_blank(), 
            axis.ticks.y=element_blank(), 
            axis.title.y=element_blank())
    
  })
  
  output$DebugText <- renderPrint({
    print(input$chromosomes)
    print(input$varieties)
    head(subset(res.df, 
                seqnames%in%input$chromosomes & 
                Variety%in%input$varieties))
    head(subset(segranges.df2, 
                seqnames%in%input$chromosomes &
                Variety%in%input$varieties))
  })
})
